subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this MemoryRerankProvider plugin SDK seam, memoryRerankProviders manifest gate, exclusive single-slot behavior, and builtin-only scope as the public v1 rerank contract?
rationale: This PR creates new third-party plugin contract surface; automation can check code shape, but it cannot decide whether this is the durable API/product direction.

options.title: Approve Generic Seam After Rebase
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned rerank provider contract, require the current-main conflict resolution to preserve abort-signal behavior, and rerun focused memory/plugin/docs checks before merge.

options.title: Revise The Contract
options.body: Request changes to the API shape, manifest gate, slot selection, or qmd scope before the public SDK surface is released.

options.title: Pause Behind RFC
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until maintainers settle the broader remote-reranker and supplement-candidate direction in the linked RFC cluster.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned rerank provider contract, require the current-main conflict resolution to preserve abort-signal behavior, and rerun focused memory/plugin/docs checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about memory architecture and public plugin SDK boundary shape, where recent history points to steipete as a strong routing candidate.
